appraisal_events.evidence: elle, qui avait renoncé à tout, trouvait pourtant, à apprendre que Mme Goupil avait à déjeuner, un plaisir aussi vif... jetant sur la pendule un coup d'œil inquiet, mais furtif pour ne pas laisser voir; déchiffrait les légendes de ses assiettes en disant 'Très bien, très bien.'
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator quietly exposes a gap between tante Léonie's professed resignation and renunciation of everything and her still-vivid, furtively hidden craving for trivial village gossip and childlike pleasures, deflating her self-image of stoic withdrawal.

status_effects.explanation: Her claimed indifference and resignation are undercut by the narrator's revelation of her furtive eagerness over trivial neighborhood news, mildly diminishing the dignity of her stated withdrawal from life.
The passage shows her entire emotional world narrowed to anticipating gossip and reading plate-legends, underscoring a confined, dependent inner life rather than any gain in standing.
